sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Sandbach have won seven of their ten games so far but come into this fixture on the back of a recent loss, though their overall form remains strong. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just four points and are in poor form, having lost five of their last six, making this an opportunity for the leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: The weekend's fixtures see several significant clashes across the division. Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of mid-table contenders. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby, before meeting Sandbach in a midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points, face Foley Meir at home. In the lower half, Shawbury United—winless in their last five—host Barnton, who are in decent form with recent wins. Brereton Social, on mixed form, begin the week at home to Widnes Town, who sit bottom with just two points. Cheadle Heath Nomads entertain Telford Town in a basement battle, Market Drayton Town host New Mills, and Crewe face Allscott Heath. These fixtures offer opportunities for struggling sides to find traction and for promotion contenders to press their claims.
